summary.text: Joshua Brant is an Independent candidate for Indiana State Senate District 23 in the November 3, 2026 general election, alongside Republican incumbent Spencer Deery and Democrat David Sanders.
A U.S. Marine Corps veteran, he describes his campaign as centered on anti-corruption and putting people over party.

paragraphs.text: Joshua Brant served in the U.S. Marine Corps from 2002 to 2007.
He earned a high school diploma from Jefferson High School and an associate degree from Ivy Tech Community College.

In a Ballotpedia survey, Brant described himself as a veteran, father and lifelong Hoosier who is running as an Independent because corruption and party loyalty, in his view, keep lawmakers from having genuine conversations about healthcare, public education and affordability.
He said he is committed to strengthening all Indiana schools and expanding access to affordable healthcare.
